question: Among frozen current-main Duskblade policy and simulation identities that naturally acquire Shatterer's Crown, does the authored facet-threshold benefit causally increase Shatter expression, and is its separately authored enemy-Fervor cost responsible for material masking or interference?
retrospectiveScope: This is a preregistered discovery experiment on one source-selected existing mechanism. It does not change acquisition, offers, policy scores, rarity, content, protected seeds or the immutable #524/#525 evidence. It cannot admit a detector, promote product content or establish held-out package support.

baseline.role: Frozen current-main natural-acquisition screen only; cohort selection reads Crown ownership, policy identity and seed identity, never a causal outcome difference.

shatterersCrownFacetThreshold.type: binary research-only causal factor outside the sampled policy vector
shatterersCrownFacetThreshold.level1: Preserve the exact current-main relic effect: after enemy facet maxima are constructed, reduce each by one with the existing floor of two.
shatterersCrownFacetThreshold.level0: Suppress only that one-facet reduction when Shatterer's Crown is owned; preserve ownership, offer and choice history, relic proc, enemy construction, Fervor and RNG.
shatterersCrownFacetThreshold.onlyDirectRead: CombatRules._apply_start_relics reads one run-local research marker inside the existing Shatterer's Crown ownership branch.

shatterersCrownFervor.type: binary research-only causal factor outside the sampled policy vector
shatterersCrownFervor.level1: Preserve the exact current-main relic cost: grant each enemy one Fervor at combat start.
shatterersCrownFervor.level0: Suppress only that one-Fervor grant when Shatterer's Crown is owned; preserve ownership, offer and choice history, relic proc, facet threshold and RNG.
shatterersCrownFervor.onlyDirectRead: CombatRules._apply_start_relics reads one separate run-local research marker inside the existing Shatterer's Crown ownership branch.

fixedNonFactors.scorelinePayoff: Fixed by the baseline content SHA and never varied.
fixedNonFactors.afterimagePayoff: Fixed separately by the baseline content SHA and never varied.
fixedNonFactors.faultlineRarity: Fixed by the baseline content SHA and never varied.
fixedNonFactors.acquisition: No offer, rarity, score, ownership or acquisition-priority intervention is permitted.
fixedNonFactors.description: Scoreline payoff and Afterimage payoff remain separate causal concepts but are not factors in this Crown experiment. This is not the retired four-factor or blind joint-factorial design.

anchors.current: Shared exact current-main anchor for both single-factor contrasts and the authored-total contrast.
anchors.bothOff: Shared no-mechanical-effect anchor that preserves natural Crown acquisition, ownership and relic proc.
anchors.noCrown: Eight preregistered policy-seed identities that do not acquire Crown. All four cells must be canonically identical and support no effect estimate.
anchors.frozenBaseline: Every current-cell analysis row, after removing trace-only metadata, must exactly equal its already cached current-main result.
anchors.expansion: The four cells are all required to identify the authored benefit, authored cost and their mechanistically plausible nonlinear survival/turn interaction. No additional joint cell may be constructed.

interactionAndAlias.justifiedInteraction: Facet threshold changes Shatter timing while Fervor changes incoming damage and survival; those paths can interact through later combat duration, routing and opportunity to Shatter, so their difference-in-differences is identified rather than assumed zero.
interactionAndAlias.aliasStructure: None. Both binary factors vary independently in a complete 2x2 within every policy-seed block. Policy identity and simulation seed are CRN blocking variables, not factors. Acquisition remains fixed and therefore is not aliased with either effect.
interactionAndAlias.claimBoundary: Downstream trajectory divergence after Crown acquisition is part of the treatment effect. Only the acquisition prefix must remain identical.

identityPreflight.surface: For Crown-owned and no-Crown focused combats, omitted settings must equal explicit null. Each non-null factor may change only its registered enemy mediator; queue, relic ownership, policy, RNG and all other state must remain exact.
identityPreflight.wholeRun: For two natural-Crown and two no-Crown frozen rows, omitted and explicit-null complete results must be canonically equal to each other and to the cached current-main row.
identityPreflight.invalidLevels: Each factor is separately probed at level 2 and must fail closed with exit 2, no output and an unregistered-level diagnostic.
identityPreflight.authority: Discovery rows execute only after every preflight assertion passes.

cohorts.policyIdentity: Policy.sample_range root 551 with the exact listed policy index; the resolved policy snapshot must be equal in every cell.
cohorts.simulationIdentity: The exact listed simulation seed is reused in every cell of its block.
cohorts.activeSelection: All and only the 32 frozen baseline policy-seed rows whose natural final relic inventory contains Shatterer's Crown. Because both treatments first act after acquisition and cannot alter offers or scoring, this is pretreatment exposure selection.
cohorts.negativeControlSelection: The lowest eight distinct baseline policy identities, taking their first simulation seed without Crown ownership.

estimands.unit: Policy identity. Repeated naturally exposed simulation seeds within a policy are averaged before inference.
estimands.primary: Cluster-mean paired difference in total whole-run Shatters for each preregistered contrast.
estimands.duration: Cluster-mean paired difference in mean combat turns per fight.
estimands.secondary: Cluster-mean paired differences in win, fault, final HP and the full threshold-by-Fervor interaction.
estimands.policySensitivity: Exact counts of policy-cluster Shatter differences greater than zero and equal to zero.
estimands.viability: Distinct policy identities in the candidate cell with at least one win and at least one Shatter on the exposed cohort.
estimands.reliability: Exact stall/error count in the candidate cell.
estimands.notEstimated: No no-Crown treatment effect, acquisition effect, offer effect, detector score, RandomBuild effect or protected-seed acceptance endpoint is estimated.

estimators.point: Unweighted arithmetic mean of within-policy mean CRN differences.
estimators.interval: Percentile bootstrap over the frozen policy-cluster values with 5000 resamples.
estimators.stopping: One fixed first look at the complete rectangle; no sequential peeking, extension or cohort replacement.

gates.effect: Both the candidate-total and its threshold-mechanism Shatter interval must have a lower 95% bound greater than zero.
gates.identity: All null, baseline, policy, no-Crown and acquisition-prefix identities pass.
gates.provenance: The eight positive, inactive and viable policy minima are the existing 64-policy first-look package-support minimum applied to the 25 naturally exposed policy identities. The Vow-5 and 0.25-turn boundaries are unchanged.

candidateSelection.shipping-shatterers-crown: Select current (threshold 1, Fervor 1) only if authoredTotal and thresholdAtFervor pass every gate.
candidateSelection.threshold-only-shatterers-crown: Otherwise select fervorOff (threshold 1, Fervor 0) only if thresholdOnlyTotal and thresholdWithoutFervor pass every gate.
candidateSelection.claimBoundary: Selection freezes at most one candidate for a newly preregistered independent held-out confirmation. It is not product promotion or package admission.

decisionRules.success: Freeze the first candidate in the preregistered order whose total, threshold-mechanism, policy-sensitivity, viability, identity, reliability, Vow-5 and duration gates all pass.
decisionRules.futility: Close the Shatterer's Crown effect family when both candidates have a fixed non-interval failure, a non-positive point or upper bound, or a duration lower bound above 0.25. Continue with the next evidence-backed structural Duskblade mechanism inside #421 without tuning this family.
decisionRules.inconclusive: Record inconclusive at the cap when neither candidate passes, at least one avoids a fixed failure but an effect or duration interval straddles its boundary, or an immutable-input, engine, cache, ledger, identity, row or wall assertion fails.
decisionRules.successAuthority: Freeze at most the selected exact Crown cell for one independent held-out confirmation with fresh policy and simulation identities plus required RandomBuild and guardrail evidence. Do not evaluate the other Crown cell, tune a level, promote product content or spend protected seeds.
decisionRules.futilityAuthority: Close this Crown effect family and continue with the next source- and evidence-backed structural Duskblade mechanism inside issue #421. Do not alter acquisition, add a Crown level or return to Ward, Kindle, Afterimage, tested #524 packages or V39-style tuning.
decisionRules.inconclusiveAuthority: Stop at the preregistered cap and record the inconclusive result. Do not extend, replace cohorts, tune thresholds or spend protected seeds.

methodBoundary: Deterministic Python constructs every row, invokes the exact simulator, uses the append-only content-addressed cache and ledger, fits only the frozen cluster bootstrap and selects the decision. No ML, RL, optimiser, candidate-by-candidate tuning or human label enters the experiment.
